content.title: Spring and fall seasons, Abela, Alentejo
content.body:
We are excited to invite volunteers to join us through our seasons at the Traditional Dream Factory, supporting every area of the regenerative farm and co-living development in Abela, Alentejo, Portugal.

We are looking for enthusiastic individuals who are interested in living, learning, and contributing to a vibrant and growing community based on respect for the land and each other. As a volunteer at TDF, you will have the chance to participate in a variety of activities, events, and workshops happening throughout the season.

content.title: Before you apply
content.body:
- [Read the Pink Paper](https://docs.google.com/document/d/177JkHCy0AhplsaEEYpFHBsiI6d4uLk0TgURSKfBIewE/edit?tab=t.0)
- [Read the visitors guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/198vWYEQCC1lELQa8f76Jcw3l3UDiPcBKt04PGFKnUvg/edit?tab=t.0)
- Any specific questions, write to the space host at space@traditionaldreamfactory.com

items.name: Daria
items.content: TDF feels like a healing sanctuary in connection with nature — a playground for dreamers and a home for community.

items.name: Charlotte
items.content: One of my favorite ecovillage projects out there!

items.name: Kyle
items.content: A place for bohemian makers, the intersection of Permaculture and crypto. My kind of place.

items.name: Rim
items.content: A special place with character. The charm of TDF is unique. Everything enchants you. You come out different. I will come back next year for sure!

items.name: Vinay
items.content: Don't come here. The community is way too kind. The nature is way too peaceful. The ideas are way too beautiful. It'll ruin your life. But maybe that's exactly what you're looking for.

items.name: Chavis
items.content: I couldn't stop thinking about TDF after my first visit. It was a rare sort of experience that left me genuinely inspired about the future.

items.name: Marcelina
items.content: I joined TDF for couple of weeks last fall and it was truly great experience! I believe in the vision of this place and I am sure there is huge potential for growth and development.

items.name: Elizabeth
items.content: My time at Traditional Dream Factory was a life-changing experience, and the people I met there will hold a special place in my heart forever.
